integrity: Proof analytic; stand-alone numerical corroboration is not an independent validation.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the squared complex position under normalized original-time phase sampling on the invariant circle; no radial or global statistical assertions. Classical SNIC/Riccati equivalence and unindexed spectral work remain priority risks.
title: Geometric harmonic spectra and an exponential spectral limit at a cubic invariant-circle degeneration
